title: psilocarphus globifer
intro: Psilocarphus globifer, commonly known as Globe-leaved Woolly-heads or Globe-leaved Pincushion, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and pain, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Psilocarphus globifer are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
